purpose: Select the next outcome-unseen target by the existing Stage47b ranking, audit PPARD source identity, and freeze a low-cost functional-complementarity pilot before ligand allocation, coordinate auditing, or docking.

selection_rule.source: unchanged Stage47b ranking: maximum metadata-eligible structure count, then maximum DUD-E clustered-active count, then target ID
selection_rule.selection_timing: PPARD selected without reading any PPARD docking or enrichment outcome

frozen_protocol.evidence_timing: Frozen after Stage54 criteria and outcome-blind PPARD source identity inspection; before molecule allocation, coordinate auditing, receptor preparation, redocking, pilot docking, enrichment evaluation, or objective fitting.

ligand_allocation.grouping: Bemis-Murcko scaffold joined with source-ID and canonical-SMILES duplicate components
ligand_allocation.failure_action: Stop before docking if exact source-ID-, canonical-SMILES-, and scaffold-disjoint allocation is infeasible.

pilot_panel.selection_rule: deterministic scaffold-group allocation independent of docking outcomes

docking.common_box: align every receptor to 2ZNP chain A; center on the K55 heavy-atom centroid; each axis is ligand span plus 12 angstrom, clamped to 22-30 angstrom

functional_diagnosis.seed_aggregation: primary seed-median score ranking with mean-seed and worst-seed robustness recorded
functional_diagnosis.active_rescue_definition: active not favorable in a majority of seeds for the baseline receptor but favorable for the pair
functional_diagnosis.decoy_promotion_definition: decoy not favorable in a majority of seeds for the baseline receptor but favorable for the pair

functional_gate.application_scope: prospective small-pilot gate for a new independently preregistered target only

gate_actions.pass: freeze the transferred QUBO objective and stopping rule, then authorize docking the remaining development-train ligands
gate_actions.fail: stop PPARD before the full development matrix and proceed to the next outcome-unseen eligible target

interpretation_boundary: Stage55 can establish outcome-blind PPARD selection, source identity, and a prospective small-pilot protocol. It cannot establish coordinate-pool adequacy, redocking success, enrichment, functional complementarity, QUBO superiority, independent validation, quantum execution, speedup, or quantum advantage.
